name: Pivot
description: Pivot a list of records into a table: one row per value of rowField, one column per value of columnField, each cell the sum of valueField (or a count when valueField is empty) — sales by region and month, tickets by team and priority. Answers { columns, rows } ready for a table.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const cols = []; const rows = new Map(); for (const it of items || []) { if (it == null) continue; const r = String(it[rowField]), c = String(it[columnField]); if (!cols.includes(c)) cols.push(c); if (!rows.has(r)) rows.set(r, { [rowField]: it[rowField] }); const row = rows.get(r); row[c] = (row[c] || 0) + (valueField ? (+it[valueField] || 0) : 1); } return { columns: [rowField, ...cols], rows: [...rows.values()] }; })() }}"}]
